contexts.text: Perhaps harm may befall him () = that... it would perish.
And harm may befall him () = to be hurt by evils and falsities. No other harm is meant in the spiritual sense, because in the Spiritual World all harm is from evils and falsities.
In these bonds... he does not inflict harm on society or the neighbour...
So that the infernal Spirits cannot inflict the least harm on him.
Miracles are not hurtful to those who...
It treats in this chapter of the injuries occasioned in various ways to the truth of faith and the good of charity; and of their amendment and restoration. AC 9145. AC 9156. AC 9157. AC 9163.
It = dissipation when the whole is broken, and injury when a part.
Those things which have not suffered injury, but resist; and those things which have suffered injury, and do not resist. Signified.
A breach = injury done to the truths and goods of faith, thus to the Church. Illustrated.
If injury is done not from fault. Signified.
In proportion as anyone is innocent, (the internals) burn to inflict harm on him.
The more simple anything simple is, the more exempt it is from injuries, because it is more perfect.
The things which inflict injury on man are from Hell.
The reason the things which inflict injury on man are called uses...
These evils are in themselves Injuries.
Hurt not the earth, the sea, and the trees () = not by a vehement, but by a moderate influx.
If anyone will hurt them, thus must he be killed () = that he who condemns them shall be in like manner condemned.
That with some the love of the sex cannot without injuries be restrained from going out into fornication.
The hurtful heresy of Arius...
The reason it is hurtful to confirm the appearances of truth which are in the Word...
This is why it is hurtful to confirm any false heresy.
Ideas which are hurtful and destructive of his salvation.
To place merit in the works which are done for the sake of salvation is hurtful...
That most harmful heresy of predestination.
That there is a great multitude of Spirits who delight in inflicting injury on others.
Hurt not the earth, etc. = lest the good perish with the evil...
It is then the delight of their life to inflict injury on and to do evil to others...
